goal: Provide each implementation-gate requirement evaluation with deterministic authoritative context capped by explicit per-section, per-item, and total character limits, so findings use only cited contracts and do not demand implementation for a regression-only or preservation/non-interception obligation whose required evidence passes.

analysis.problem: Implementation-gate requirement evaluation currently relies on isolated requirement text and mapped diffs without matching acceptance criteria, linked constraints and decisions, schema contracts, task ownership, or file-map ownership. It can therefore misread preservation or regression obligations as implementation work and invent fields, outcomes, or rejection rules absent from those sources.
analysis.proposedApproach: Construct a per-requirement context with explicit item and character caps from linked requirement, acceptance, constraint, decision, schema, task, ownership, file-map, and diff evidence; classify the obligation explicitly; and require source-type plus stable-index citations in evaluation reasons.
analysis.validation: Use repeated-build byte-equality tests; PASS regressions modeled on Issue #432 R6 and Issue #434 R7; FAIL cases where cited context requires changed behavior, an exact field, preservation, or regression evidence that the implementation omits; and existing coverage for counters, caching, result schema, routing, and target-guard ordering.

knownFacts: must: Requirement evaluation currently receives requirement text and mapped diffs but omits matching acceptance criteria, linked constraints and decisions, schema contracts, task ownership, and file-map ownership.
must: Issue #432 R6 demonstrates a preservation-only obligation incorrectly treated as reimplementation work.
must: Issue #434 R7 demonstrates rejection of safe canonical path a/../x and invention of a nonexistent mergeOutcome field.
must: The existing implementation gate owns semantic counters, cache behavior, result schema, routing, and target guards that this bugfix must preserve.
must: The linked Issue and assignment approve its stated scope and exclusions as the complete product boundary for this bugfix.
decisionPoints: must: Context selection must use deterministic requirement ID and ownership linkage rather than unrelated full-spec dumping.
must: Obligation classification must distinguish implementation, regression-only, and preservation/non-interception evaluation semantics.
must: Finding reasons must cite the authoritative context actually used through stable source references.
must: Explicit section, item, and character or token-equivalent bounds must make identical inputs produce identical prompt bytes and cache identity.
resolvedByProjectRules: must: Use only Node.js built-in modules and add no external dependency.
must: Express meaningful structured values with dedicated classes that enforce invariants and own rendering behavior.
must: Validate run, Issue, and spec target guards before context construction, cache or agent access, and mutation.
must: Preserve the Issue as one specification concern and avoid compatibility shims during alpha development.
deferredToSpec: must: Define measurable per-section, per-item, total character, and deterministic truncation limits within the existing prompt budget.
must: Define authoritative linkage rules and stable citation identifiers for every included source type.
must: Map every requirement and acceptance criterion to implementation tasks and to agent-independent or end-to-end tests named by covered requirement ID.

in: must: Update implementation-gate context and prompt construction in src/flow/lib/run-gate.js; add one helper module only if it owns a context value class reused by both selection and rendering and prevents duplicate invariant enforcement.

must: Include full requirement text and sources connected by requirement ID, acceptance-criterion requirement reference, task requirementIds or implementationTargets, file-map requirement key, or an explicit schema, constraint, decision, ownership, or data-flow reference in the requirement or its matched acceptance criteria.

must: Add prompt/context unit tests for byte equality, ordering, truncation, citations, and all obligation types; add end-to-end cases for Issue #432 R6 PASS and preservation/regression-evidence FAIL, Issue #434 R7 PASS without mergeOutcome or safe-path rejection, and a FAIL where cited context requires omitted changed behavior or an exact field.

must: Return FAIL when a cited requirement or acceptance criterion requires changed behavior, an integration, an exact field, preservation, or regression evidence and the mapped implementation or test evidence omits or contradicts it.
out: must: Do not add a gate bypass, defer path, or manual finding disposition.
must: Do not reset or extend semantic retry counters or repair prior Issue #432 or Issue #434 state.
must: Do not add behavior, schema fields, outcomes, or rejection rules absent from authoritative context.
must: Do not add dependencies, public compatibility shims, push, publish, or release operations.

impactOnExisting: must: Requirement-evaluation prompt bytes and cache identities may change only as a deterministic consequence of the new authoritative context.
must: Semantic gate counters, retry accounting, cache semantics, persisted result schema, task and integration routing, and file-map reconciliation behavior must remain unchanged.
must: Target mismatch handling must remain first and leave state and artifacts byte-identical before any context, agent, cache, or mutation work.

should: The requirement-call batch must remain at or below MAX_IMPL_REQUIREMENT_BATCH_CHARS (120000 characters), and every agent prompt must remain at or below MAX_AGENT_PROMPT_INPUT_CHARS (900000 characters), without including sources lacking a defined requirement or ownership linkage.

qa.question: must: Issue #436 の範囲を、要件ごとの権威ある文脈付与、義務種別の明示、安定した引用、既知の誤判定回帰、真の欠落動作の検出、および既存ゲート契約の維持に限定してよいですか。
qa.droppedReason: Issue #436 の Scope、Requirements、Acceptance Criteria、Out of Scope と親タスクの approved scope が同じ境界を明示しており、追加のユーザー判断を必要としないためです。

approval.notes: Issue #436 and the parent-approved assignment define the accepted scope and exclusions.
